title: Waste management element objectives
text: O4.17.1 Waste storage facilities minimise negative impacts on the streetscape, building entries and the amenity of residents. O4.17.2 Waste to landfill is minimised by providing safe and convenient bins and information for the separation and recycling of waste.
notes: Register C4P2-129: Vol2 Appendix A6 (summary list of all element objectives) is deleted with no draft equivalent, so these O records are the only listing of the 4.x objectives.
